title: thelypteris pauciloba
intro: Thelypteris pauciloba, commonly known as the forked fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Thelypteridaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris pauciloba are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which help in soothing infections and reducing pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
